new_opportunity: Sanctum of Stone Fangs is a verified {1}{B} resilient noncreature START-OF-FIRST-MAIN repeatable each-opponent life-loss source. At only one Shrine, it causes one loss to each of three opponents (X=3) BEFORE any ordinary main-phase spell that turn. If Abaddon is already on the battlefield, the first hand spell with printed MV<=3 can now receive Abaddon-granted cascade without needing Boltwave/Loyal or a previously cast spell. This examines a different timing horizon from Veyran/Impact and cannot be dismissed by prior tested-pool local best.

timing_proofs.fixture: Sanctum survived from a prior turn; own FIRST main begins, three opponents; Abaddon already on battlefield; stack clear after Shrine trigger.
events: At first-main beginning, Sanctum triggered life loss resolves: each opponent loses1, X=3.
Cast Wheel of Fortune or Windfall from hand, printed MV3; Abaddon STATIC grant sees X3 BEFORE casting, so spell gains cascade and trigger occurs as it is CAST.
Any newly created life loss after spell cast does not retroactively enable its own cascade; later hand spells may use larger X.
timing_proofs.qualifiers: No draw/top manipulation is guaranteed; a mana-payable Wheel/Windfall is necessary; opponents can answer trigger/permanent; Abaddon casting itself did not receive its own cascade.

timing_proofs.fixture: Sanctum, Bloodletter and Solphim on own FIRST main (3 opponents), and one Shrine
events: Sanctum causes LOSS OF LIFE, not damage, so Solphim's noncombat-damage replacement does NOT double it.
Bloodletter replaces one life lost during your turn with two per opponent, so X increases from 3 to 6.
This larger X is present before the next hand spell and can allow up to MV6 to receive Abaddon-granted cascade if Abaddon is already in play.
timing_proofs.qualifiers: Bloodletter must be on battlefield and its replacement apply to the opponents; Sanctum's life gain is unaffected.

timing_proofs.fixture: Sanctum cast and resolved in ordinary precombat first main
events: Its beginning-of-first-main trigger opportunity for the current turn already passed; no immediate life loss.
Next own first main triggers if it remains battlefield.
timing_proofs.qualifiers: Do not credit the enchantment as same-turn instant threshold on initial cast.

timing_proofs.fixture: Mirkwood Bats {3}{B} plus The Lost and the Damned, Prosper/Storm-Kiln, and three opponents
events: One Spawn TOKEN created by qualifying nonhand spell cast triggers Bats once: each opponent loses1, X+3.
A Treasure TOKEN created by Prosper or Storm-Kiln triggers Bats once: X+3; sacrificing that Treasure separately triggers Bats once more: another X+3.

An instant/sorcery cast/copy may trigger Veyran-enhanced PROSPER/LOST/STORM-KILN first, yielding additional distinct token creation events; Veyran does not double Bats directly because creation/sacrifice is the proximate trigger.
timing_proofs.qualifiers: If a Treasure is sacrificed while paying for the same spell, Bats' triggered life loss will RESOLVE AFTER that spell is cast and cannot retroactively raise the Abaddon X for that casting. Sacrifice in advance as a distinct priority window, let Bat's trigger resolve and float mana within phase if threshold is required first. No generic token-infinite combo implied.

timing_proofs.fixture: Opposing Rule of Law active on first main; Sanctum gives X3; Abaddon in play
events: Hand MV3 spell can gain cascade, but once the original is cast, Rule of Law forbids casting its exiled cascade hit as a SECOND spell.
Sanctum supplies life loss but does not evade this independent anti-storm limitation.
timing_proofs.qualifiers: The predeployed Neheb/Assault/Loyal route from Stage10 remains the independent Rule-of-Law-tolerant line.

three_complete_100_research_variants.name: SANCTUM_ONLY_THE_RUINOUS_CUT
three_complete_100_research_variants.strength: Start-of-first-main X3 reliable early cascade seed without other pinger or a first cast; two-mana rather than four.
three_complete_100_research_variants.cost: Loses protected Warhammer 40K opponent library exile land/spell access and ownership life loss; Shrine yields only X3 and needs survive to next own main.

three_complete_100_research_variants.name: SANCTUM_IMPACT_KEEP_FAMILIAR
three_complete_100_research_variants.strength: First-main predictable life-loss threshold + commander-independent Ignus damage win outlet; preserves Familiar mana, Neheb combat, shield counters and other 40K payoffs.
three_complete_100_research_variants.cost: Loses one-MV cantrip selection and protected Ruinous theft, lacks Veyran doubling broad Warhammer cast triggers.

three_complete_100_research_variants.name: SANCTUM_IMPACT_BATS_CHALLENGE_NOISE_MARINE
three_complete_100_research_variants.strength: One pre-main repeatable threshold + one direct Ignus ETB outlet + 40K Spawn/Treasure creation and sacrifice life-loss payoffs; mixed engines reach beyond only instant/sorcery casts.
three_complete_100_research_variants.cost: Loses Noise Marine's printed cascade and 40K sonic blaster single-target, alongside Ruinous theft and Ponder selection; Bats four-mana creature is removable and token-dependent; no demonstrated whole-deck superiority.

side_by_side.incremental_early_threshold: None by itself on first main; requires existing instant/sorcery-induced PERMANENT trigger to build X.
side_by_side.conditional_ceiling: Doubles up to ten current permanents' contextual spell-induced triggers; high on existing nonhand board.

side_by_side.incremental_early_threshold: X3 at first main with one Shrine and no other engine/first cast, starting following turn.
side_by_side.conditional_ceiling: Less explosive than Veyran at high spell-count; Impact direct win loop unchanged.

side_by_side.incremental_early_threshold: X3 from Sanctum before first-main hand spell plus token event bursts later in turn.
side_by_side.conditional_ceiling: Treasure creation and sacrifice X contributions even outside instant/sorcery direct cast; Lost Spawn synergy.
side_by_side.key_sacrifice: Additional Noise Marine printed cascade and 40K identity, serious quality cost.

comparative_adversarial.precommitted_judgment: Sanctum is the strongest further distinct PRE-MAIN-THRESHOLD challenger with robust cheap enchantment timing, and must be honestly compared against the Ruinous slot and Veyran. Its ability is deterministic only once already deployed; it's not a same-turn spell fix. The three-add package demonstrates additional synergies but its cuts lose protected cascade/Warhammer. Retain them as adversarial research, not owner-ready improvements. Structural exact 100 and source legality are necessary, not a final power proof.

material_candidate_judgments.reason: Repeatable beginning-first-main own-turn X3 at only {1}{B} with resilient enchantment body, supporting Abaddon hand MV3 cascade. Four-player X3 is meaningful, but loses protected opponent-library theft and one-turn delay.
Higher conditional power on cast/copy spell board, but no independent pre-main threshold and costs {1}{U}{R}. Neither approach strictly dominates.
Birgi/Ignus outlet and Spawn ETB value; loses one-mana selection and MV1 cascade hit.

Sources token creation and sacrifice loss across Treasure and Spawn engines, but 4MV removable creature cannot replace free printed cascade and single-target sonic reach without full-board payoff proof.
MV2 ping from repeated Treasure artifact entries, better cheap start versus 4-MV Bats but excludes nonartifact Spawn and token sacrifice; evaluate when Treasure density is high.
Upkeep all-opponent one damage with lifegain, boosted by Solphim; 1/2 body dies to creature removal whereas Sanctum enchantment remains an independent low-MV life-loss source.
